# Grow a Garden 2 Calculator

> Free, no-ads, unofficial Grow a Garden 2 tools using versioned community data. Not affiliated with Roblox or the game developers.

## Data policy

- Crop Base Sell Value is Sheckles; Seed Purchase Price is shop cost; Relative Trade Value is a separate market unit. Never merge these fields.
- Crop and formula data uses versioned Grow a Garden 2 Fandom revisions. Relative trade values use a dated GAG2.GG snapshot and methodology.
- A crop can carry one mutation at a time. Unreleased mutations are excluded from calculator defaults.
- No reliable public live-stock feed is used. Stock pages are timers and local watchlists, not predictions or live inventory claims.
- No reliable GAG2 pet age/weight formula was found. Pet pages use sourced ability and per-pet variant facts instead of importing a Grow a Garden 1 formula.
- Codes are `Reported active` with a source-check date, not claimed as personally redeemed.
- The official Roblox identity checked on 2026-08-04 is Place `97598239454123`, Universe `10200395747`, creator `Strawberreh Squad`.
- Tools do not support cash, Robux, account transfers, passwords, cookies, tokens, scripts, or trade guarantees.
